displayName: OCI-WSTG04-002: Default Credentials Usage on Login
description:
Detects successful logins using common default usernames like admin, root, or test across services

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg04_002", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%default%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%credentials%') AND "value" > 0
